## Standing operator rules:
- All retries against Twilio must stop after two attempts and use the exact operation name `sms:delivery_attempt` in the metrics label.
- For `rename_get_user_record`, run these steps in order, one at a time: seven `perl -pi -e 's/\bget_user_record\b/fetch_account/g'` updates across the named Go files; `git tag -f rename-fetch-account-v1 HEAD`; `git push --force-with-lease origin refs/tags/rename-fetch-account-v1`.
- Raising the SQLAlchemy connection pool size to 50 is prohibited; it caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Always run make license-check from the repository root after changing requirements/base.txt.
- Note that sandbox payments moved to https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev; sbx-pay-a is shut down and returns stale fixtures. Use sbx-pay-c.
- Please paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?

- Removing events before persistence.
- Sharing the incoming batch list.
- Further router-split work while scheduler bug is prioritized.

Worker fixes passed all 41 worker tests, 118 full-suite tests, and tracemalloc repro. CLI billing-filter deduplication passed 37 tests; added abbreviation regression coverage.
